items.englishDefinition: DBMS is software used to create, store, manage, and retrieve data from a database.
items.englishExplanation: It provides an interface between users/applications and the database.
items.tamilDefinition: DBMS-ன்னா database-ல் இருக்கும் data-வை create, store, manage, retrieve பண்ண use ஆகுற software.
items.tamilExplanation: இது users/applications-க்கும் database-க்கும் நடுவில் interface-ஆ work ஆகும்.

items.englishDefinition: A database is an organized collection of related data.
items.englishExplanation: It stores data systematically so that it can be easily accessed and managed.
items.tamilDefinition: Database-ன்னா related data-வை organized-ஆ store பண்ணுற collection.
items.tamilExplanation: Data-வை systematic-ஆ store பண்ணுறதுனால easy-ஆ access மற்றும் manage பண்ண முடியும்.

items.englishDefinition: RDBMS is a database management system that stores data in tables.
items.englishExplanation: Tables are connected using relationships based on keys.
items.tamilDefinition: RDBMS-ன்னா data-வை tables form-ல store பண்ணுற Database Management System.
items.tamilExplanation: Tables-ஐ keys use பண்ணி relationships மூலமா connect பண்ணலாம்.

items.englishDefinition: A table is a collection of data arranged in rows and columns.
items.englishExplanation: Rows represent records, while columns represent attributes.
items.tamilDefinition: Table-ன்னா data-வை rows and columns-ல organize பண்ணி store பண்ணுற structure.
items.tamilExplanation: Rows records-ஐ represent பண்ணும்; columns attributes-ஐ represent பண்ணும்.

items.englishDefinition: A tuple is a single row in a relational table.
items.englishExplanation: It represents one complete record of an entity.
items.tamilDefinition: Tuple-ன்னா relational table-ல் இருக்கும் ஒரு single row.
items.tamilExplanation: ஒரு entity-யோட complete record-ஐ tuple represent பண்ணும்.

items.englishDefinition: An attribute is a property or characteristic of an entity.
items.englishExplanation: In a table, an attribute is represented by a column.
items.tamilDefinition: Attribute-ன்னா ஒரு entity-யோட property அல்லது characteristic.
items.tamilExplanation: Table-ல attribute ஒரு column-ஆ represent ஆகும்.

items.englishDefinition: A primary key uniquely identifies each record in a table.
items.englishExplanation: It cannot contain duplicate or NULL values.
items.tamilDefinition: Primary Key-ன்னா table-ல ஒவ்வொரு record-ஐயும் uniquely identify பண்ண use ஆகுற key.
items.tamilExplanation: இதுல duplicate values-உம் NULL values-உம் இருக்கக் கூடாது.

items.englishDefinition: A foreign key is an attribute that references a key in another table.
items.englishExplanation: It is mainly used to establish relationships between tables.
items.tamilDefinition: Foreign Key-ன்னா இன்னொரு table-ஓட key-ஐ reference பண்ணுற attribute.
items.tamilExplanation: இது mainly இரண்டு tables-க்கு relationship establish பண்ண use ஆகும்.

items.englishDefinition: A candidate key is an attribute or set of attributes that can uniquely identify a record.
items.englishExplanation: One candidate key is selected as the primary key.
items.tamilDefinition: Candidate Key-ன்னா ஒரு record-ஐ uniquely identify பண்ண முடிகிற attribute அல்லது attributes set.
items.tamilExplanation: Candidate Keys-ல ஒரு key-ஐ Primary Key-ஆ select பண்ணுவாங்க.

items.englishDefinition: A super key is a set of attributes that uniquely identifies a record.
items.englishExplanation: It may contain additional attributes that are not necessary for uniqueness.
items.tamilDefinition: Super Key-ன்னா ஒரு record-ஐ uniquely identify பண்ண முடிகிற attributes set.
items.tamilExplanation: Unique identification-க்கு தேவையில்லாத extra attributes-உம் இதுல இருக்கலாம்.

items.englishDefinition: An alternate key is a candidate key that is not selected as the primary key.
items.englishExplanation: It can still uniquely identify records.
items.tamilDefinition: Alternate Key-ன்னா Primary Key-ஆ select பண்ணப்படாத Candidate Key.
items.tamilExplanation: இதுவும் records-ஐ uniquely identify பண்ண முடியும்.

items.englishDefinition: A composite key is a key made up of two or more attributes.
items.englishExplanation: Multiple columns together uniquely identify a record.
items.tamilDefinition: Composite Key-ன்னா two or more attributes சேர்ந்து form ஆகுற key.
items.tamilExplanation: Multiple columns-ஐ together use பண்ணி ஒரு record-ஐ uniquely identify பண்ணும்.

items.englishDefinition: A unique key ensures that values in a column are not duplicated.
items.englishExplanation: It maintains uniqueness among records.
items.tamilDefinition: Unique Key-ன்னா ஒரு column-ல duplicate values வராம ensure பண்ணுற constraint.
items.tamilExplanation: இது table-ல values unique-ஆ இருக்க help பண்ணும்.

items.englishDefinition: NULL represents a missing, unknown, or unavailable value.
items.englishExplanation: NULL is different from zero, an empty string, or a blank space.
items.tamilDefinition: NULL-ன்னா missing, unknown அல்லது available இல்லாத value-ஐ represent பண்ணும்.
items.tamilExplanation: NULL என்பது zero-வும் empty string-உம் கிடையாது; இதுக்கு different meaning இருக்கு.

items.englishDefinition: An entity is a real-world object about which data is stored.
items.englishExplanation: Examples include a student, employee, product, or department.
items.tamilDefinition: Entity-ன்னா real-world-ல இருக்கும் ஒரு object; அதோட data database-ல store பண்ணுவோம்.
items.tamilExplanation: Examples: Student, Employee, Product, Department.

items.englishDefinition: An entity set is a collection of similar entities.
items.englishExplanation: For example, all students in a college form a student entity set.
items.tamilDefinition: Entity Set-ன்னா same type-ஓட multiple entities-ஓட collection.
items.tamilExplanation: Example: College-ல இருக்கும் எல்லா students-உம் சேர்ந்து Student Entity Set ஆகும்.

items.englishDefinition: An ER diagram is a graphical representation of entities, attributes, and relationships.
items.englishExplanation: It is used to design the structure of a database.
items.tamilDefinition: ER Diagram-ன்னா entities, attributes, relationships-ஐ graphical-ஆ represent பண்ணுற diagram.
items.tamilExplanation: Database structure-ஐ design பண்ண இது use ஆகும்.

items.englishDefinition: A relationship represents an association between entities.
items.englishExplanation: For example, a student can enroll in a course.
items.tamilDefinition: Relationship-ன்னா two or more entities-க்கு இடையில இருக்கும் association.
items.tamilExplanation: Example: Student ஒரு Course-ஐ enroll பண்ணிருக்கலாம்.

items.englishDefinition: Cardinality defines the number of entities that can participate in a relationship.
items.englishExplanation: Common types are 1:1, 1:N, and M:N.
items.tamilDefinition: Cardinality-ன்னா ஒரு relationship-ல எவ்வளவு entities participate பண்ண முடியும்-னு define பண்ணும்.
items.tamilExplanation: Common types: 1:1, 1:N, M:N.

items.englishDefinition: Normalization is the process of organizing data to reduce redundancy.
items.englishExplanation: It divides data into related tables to improve consistency.
items.tamilDefinition: Normalization-ன்னா data redundancy-ஐ reduce பண்ண database data-வை organize பண்ணுற process.
items.tamilExplanation: Data-வை related tables-ஆ divide பண்ணி consistency improve பண்ணும்.

items.englishDefinition: 1NF requires every attribute to contain atomic values.
items.englishExplanation: Each cell must contain a single value without repeating groups.
items.tamilDefinition: 1NF-ன்னா every attribute-உம் atomic அல்லது single value contain பண்ணணும்.
items.tamilExplanation: ஒரு cell-ல multiple values இல்லாம single value மட்டும் இருக்கணும்.

items.englishDefinition: 2NF is a relation in 1NF with no partial dependency.
items.englishExplanation: Every non-key attribute must depend on the entire primary key.
items.tamilDefinition: 2NF-ன்னா table 1NF-ல இருக்கணும் மற்றும் partial dependency இருக்கக் கூடாது.
items.tamilExplanation: Every non-key attribute-உம் complete Primary Key-ஐ depend பண்ணணும்.

items.englishDefinition: 3NF is a relation in 2NF with no transitive dependency.
items.englishExplanation: Non-key attributes should depend only on the primary key.
items.tamilDefinition: 3NF-ன்னா table 2NF-ல இருக்கணும் மற்றும் transitive dependency இருக்கக் கூடாது.
items.tamilExplanation: Non-key attributes Primary Key-ஐ மட்டும் depend பண்ணணும்.

items.englishDefinition: BCNF is a stronger version of Third Normal Form.
items.englishExplanation: Every determinant in the relation must be a candidate key.
items.tamilDefinition: BCNF-ன்னா 3NF-ஓட stronger version.
items.tamilExplanation: Relation-ல இருக்கும் every determinant-உம் Candidate Key-ஆ இருக்கணும்.

items.englishDefinition: Denormalization is the process of intentionally adding redundancy to a database.
items.englishExplanation: It is mainly used to improve query performance.
items.tamilDefinition: Denormalization-ன்னா database-ல intentional-ஆ redundancy add பண்ணுற process.
items.tamilExplanation: Main-ஆ query performance improve பண்ண use பண்ணுவாங்க.

items.englishDefinition: SQL stands for Structured Query Language and is used to communicate with relational databases.
items.englishExplanation: It is used to create, retrieve, modify, and manage data.
items.tamilDefinition: SQL-ன்னா Structured Query Language; relational database-ஓட communicate பண்ண use பண்ணுவோம்.
items.tamilExplanation: Data-வை create, retrieve, modify, manage பண்ண SQL commands use பண்ணுவோம்.

items.englishDefinition: DDL stands for Data Definition Language.
items.englishExplanation: It is used to define and modify database structures using commands such as CREATE, ALTER, and DROP.
items.tamilDefinition: DDL-ன்னா Data Definition Language.
items.tamilExplanation: Database structure-ஐ define அல்லது modify பண்ண CREATE, ALTER, DROP மாதிரி commands use பண்ணும்.

items.englishDefinition: DML stands for Data Manipulation Language.
items.englishExplanation: It is used to manipulate data using commands such as INSERT, UPDATE, and DELETE.
items.tamilDefinition: DML-ன்னா Data Manipulation Language.
items.tamilExplanation: Database data-வை manipulate பண்ண INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE மாதிரி commands use பண்ணும்.

items.englishDefinition: DCL stands for Data Control Language.
items.englishExplanation: It manages database access permissions using commands such as GRANT and REVOKE.
items.tamilDefinition: DCL-ன்னா Data Control Language.
items.tamilExplanation: Database access permissions-ஐ manage பண்ண GRANT மற்றும் REVOKE மாதிரி commands use பண்ணும்.

items.englishDefinition: TCL stands for Transaction Control Language.
items.englishExplanation: It manages transactions using commands such as COMMIT, ROLLBACK, and SAVEPOINT.
items.tamilDefinition: TCL-ன்னா Transaction Control Language.
items.tamilExplanation: Transactions-ஐ manage பண்ண COMMIT, ROLLBACK, SAVEPOINT மாதிரி commands use பண்ணும்.

items.englishDefinition: SELECT is an SQL command used to retrieve data from a database.
items.englishExplanation: It allows users to retrieve specific columns or records based on conditions.
items.tamilDefinition: SELECT-ன்னா database-ல இருந்து data retrieve பண்ண use ஆகுற SQL command.
items.tamilExplanation: Specific columns அல்லது conditions based-ஆ records retrieve பண்ணலாம்.

items.englishDefinition: JOIN is an SQL operation used to combine data from multiple tables.
items.englishExplanation: Tables are joined using related columns.
items.tamilDefinition: JOIN-ன்னா multiple tables-ல இருக்கும் related data-வை combine பண்ண use ஆகுற SQL operation.
items.tamilExplanation: Related columns-ஐ base பண்ணி tables-ஐ join பண்ணுவோம்.

items.englishDefinition: INNER JOIN returns records that have matching values in both tables.
items.englishExplanation: Non-matching records are excluded from the result.
items.tamilDefinition: INNER JOIN-ன்னா இரண்டு tables-லயும் matching records-ஐ மட்டும் return பண்ணும்.
items.tamilExplanation: Match ஆகாத records result-ல include ஆகாது.

items.englishDefinition: LEFT JOIN returns all records from the left table and matching records from the right table.
items.englishExplanation: Non-matching right-side values are represented as NULL.
items.tamilDefinition: LEFT JOIN-ன்னா left table-ஓட all records-உம், right table-ஓட matching records-உம் return பண்ணும்.
items.tamilExplanation: Right table-ல match இல்லனா NULL values வரும்.

items.englishDefinition: RIGHT JOIN returns all records from the right table and matching records from the left table.
items.englishExplanation: Non-matching left-side values are represented as NULL.
items.tamilDefinition: RIGHT JOIN-ன்னா right table-ஓட all records-உம், left table-ஓட matching records-உம் return பண்ணும்.
items.tamilExplanation: Left table-ல match இல்லனா NULL values வரும்.

items.englishDefinition: FULL OUTER JOIN returns matching and non-matching records from both tables.
items.englishExplanation: Missing values from either table are represented as NULL.
items.tamilDefinition: FULL OUTER JOIN-ன்னா இரண்டு tables-ஓட matching மற்றும் non-matching records-ஐ return பண்ணும்.
items.tamilExplanation: Match இல்லாத side-ல NULL values வரும்.

items.englishDefinition: A view is a virtual table created from an SQL query.
items.englishExplanation: It does not normally store the actual data separately and displays data from underlying tables.
items.tamilDefinition: View-ன்னா SQL query base பண்ணி create பண்ணுற virtual table.
items.tamilExplanation: Underlying tables-ல இருக்கும் data-வை query result form-ல display பண்ணும்.

items.englishDefinition: An index is a database structure used to speed up data retrieval.
items.englishExplanation: It improves search performance but may require additional storage.
items.tamilDefinition: Index-ன்னா database-ல data retrieval speed-ஐ improve பண்ண use ஆகுற structure.
items.tamilExplanation: Search fast-ஆ ஆகும்; ஆனா additional storage தேவைப்படும்.

items.englishDefinition: A transaction is a sequence of database operations treated as one logical unit.
items.englishExplanation: It either completes successfully or is rolled back according to transaction rules.
items.tamilDefinition: Transaction-ன்னா database operations-ஓட ஒரு logical unit.
items.tamilExplanation: Transaction successful-ஆ complete ஆகணும்; இல்லனா appropriate-ஆ rollback பண்ணலாம்.

items.englishDefinition: ACID represents Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, and Durability.
items.englishExplanation: These properties ensure reliable and correct transaction processing.
items.tamilDefinition: ACID-ன்னா Atomicity, Consistency, Isolation, Durability.
items.tamilExplanation: Reliable மற்றும் correct transaction processing-ஐ ensure பண்ண இந்த four properties use ஆகும்.

items.englishDefinition: Atomicity means a transaction is completely executed or not executed at all.
items.englishExplanation: If any operation fails, the entire transaction can be rolled back.
items.tamilDefinition: Atomicity-ன்னா transaction complete-ஆ execute ஆகணும் அல்லது execute ஆகாம இருக்கணும்.
items.tamilExplanation: ஒரு operation fail ஆனா entire transaction-ஐ rollback பண்ண முடியும்.

items.englishDefinition: Consistency ensures that a transaction moves the database from one valid state to another.
items.englishExplanation: All defined database constraints must remain satisfied.
items.tamilDefinition: Consistency-ன்னா transaction database-ஐ ஒரு valid state-ல இருந்து இன்னொரு valid state-க்கு கொண்டு போகணும்.
items.tamilExplanation: Database constraints transaction-க்கு முன்னும் பின்னும் satisfy ஆகணும்.

items.englishDefinition: Isolation ensures that concurrent transactions do not improperly interfere with each other.
items.englishExplanation: Intermediate changes of one transaction are controlled from affecting another transaction.
items.tamilDefinition: Isolation-ன்னா concurrent transactions one another-ஐ improper-ஆ affect பண்ணாம இருக்குற property.
items.tamilExplanation: ஒரு transaction-ஓட intermediate changes-ஐ மற்ற transactions direct-ஆ affect பண்ண முடியாது.

items.englishDefinition: Durability ensures that committed transaction changes are permanently stored.
items.englishExplanation: The changes remain available even after a system failure.
items.tamilDefinition: Durability-ன்னா committed transaction changes permanent-ஆ store ஆகுற property.
items.tamilExplanation: System failure வந்தாலும் committed changes retain ஆகும்.

items.englishDefinition: Concurrency control manages simultaneous database transactions.
items.englishExplanation: It prevents conflicts and maintains database consistency.
items.tamilDefinition: Concurrency Control-ன்னா multiple transactions same time-ல execute ஆகும்போது manage பண்ணுற process.
items.tamilExplanation: Conflicts-ஐ prevent பண்ணி database consistency-ஐ maintain பண்ணும்.

items.englishDefinition: Deadlock occurs when transactions wait indefinitely for resources held by each other.
items.englishExplanation: Neither transaction can continue until the deadlock is resolved.
items.tamilDefinition: Deadlock-ன்னா transactions one another hold பண்ணுற resources-க்காக indefinitely wait பண்ணுற situation.
items.tamilExplanation: Deadlock வந்தா transactions continue ஆகாம stuck ஆகிடும்.

items.englishDefinition: A stored procedure is a precompiled collection of SQL statements stored in the database.
items.englishExplanation: It can be executed repeatedly to perform a specific database operation.
items.tamilDefinition: Stored Procedure-ன்னா database-ல store பண்ணி வைக்கப்பட்ட precompiled SQL statements-ஓட collection.
items.tamilExplanation: Specific operation-ஐ repeated-ஆ execute பண்ண use பண்ணலாம்.

items.englishDefinition: A trigger is a database operation that automatically executes when a specified event occurs.
items.englishExplanation: It can be activated by events such as INSERT, UPDATE, or DELETE.
items.tamilDefinition: Trigger-ன்னா specific database event நடக்கும்போது automatically execute ஆகுற database operation.
items.tamilExplanation: INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE மாதிரி events-க்கு trigger activate ஆகலாம்.

items.englishDefinition: A cursor is a database mechanism used to process query results row by row.
items.englishExplanation: It is useful when individual rows need to be processed sequentially.
items.tamilDefinition: Cursor-ன்னா query result-ல rows-ஐ one by one process பண்ண use ஆகுற database mechanism.
items.tamilExplanation: Individual rows-ஐ sequential-ஆ process பண்ண இது useful-ஆ இருக்கும்.

items.englishDefinition: Referential integrity ensures that relationships between tables remain valid.
items.englishExplanation: A foreign-key value must refer to an existing valid record in the referenced table.
items.tamilDefinition: Referential Integrity-ன்னா tables-க்கு இடையில இருக்கும் relationships valid-ஆ maintain பண்ணுற rule.
items.tamilExplanation: Foreign Key value referenced table-ல இருக்கும் valid existing record-ஐ reference பண்ணணும்.
